==Biography==

== Trivia ==
* Usually known for popping off and surprising fans during most of the playoffs stage he participates, which led to people calling him '''"Envy dos Playoffs"'''.<ref>[https://twitter.com/ilhadaslendas/status/1695870216666791974 Ilha das Lendas' Tweet] ''twitter.com''</ref>
* His TP in his own base in the end of the game between [[Los Grandes]] and [[Liberty]] during [[CBLOL 2024 Split 2]] was mocked by the whole Brazilian community, comparing it to [[Tay|Tay's]] {{ci|urgot}} TP during [[Worlds 2020]] and [[LEP|LEP's]] {{ci|lulu}} TP during [[Worlds 2014]].<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=giAn4c75AaU INACREDITÁVEL! Streamers reagem ao TP do Envy e DERROTA da Los] ''youtube.com''</ref>
* Infamously known for his {{ci|taliyah}}, which he holds a 15% winrate.
* He is one of the only players in the world to achieve only pentakills in games that ended in defeat.

===Equipment===
* Mouse: Razer Viper V3
* Keyboard: Logitech G915 X TKL
* Mousepad: Artisan FX Hien
